hooks.command:
cfg="${CODEX_PROJECT_DIR:-${OLDPWD:-$PWD}}/.agents/team.toml"; fallback="${CODEX_PROJECT_DIR:-${OLDPWD:-$PWD}}/.codex/team.toml"; legacy="${CODEX_PROJECT_DIR:-${OLDPWD:-$PWD}}/.codex/team.config"; if [ -f "$cfg" ]; then printf '=== mARC :: per-repo team.toml (channel topic) ===
'; cat "$cfg"; printf '
=== end team.toml ===
'; elif [ -f "$fallback" ]; then printf '=== mARC :: per-repo team.toml (channel topic) ===
'; cat "$fallback"; printf '
=== end team.toml ===
'; printf '[mARC] DEPRECATED path: .codex/team.toml — re-run /marc:init to migrate to .agents/team.toml (it will offer to remove the old file).
'; elif [ -f "$legacy" ]; then printf '[mARC] DEPRECATED: .codex/team.config found but mARC now reads .agents/team.toml (or .codex/team.toml as a fallback) — re-run /marc:init (or convert by hand from docs/team.toml.example) to migrate; the old .codex/team.config file is no longer parsed.
'; else printf '[mARC] no .agents/team.toml (or .codex/team.toml) in this repo — @techlead will fall back to runtime discovery (gh repo view / gh project list). Add one from docs/team.toml.example to pin repo/project facts.
'; fi; exit 0

export CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-$PWD}"; export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="${CODEX_PROJECT_DIR:-${OLDPWD:-$PWD}}"; script="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-$PWD}/hooks/outdated-check.sh"; if [ -f "$script" ]; then bash "$script" 2>/dev/null; else st="${MARC_STATE_DIR:-$HOME/.claude/marc-state}/hook-missing"; mkdir -p "$st" 2>/dev/null; sid="$(cat 2>/dev/null | LC_ALL=C sed -n -e 's/.*"session_id"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' -e 's/.*"conversationId"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -n1)"; sid="${sid:-${ANTIGRAVITY_CONVERSATION_ID:-$PPID}}"; mk="$st/$(printf '%s' "${sid:-nosession}_outdated-check.sh" | LC_ALL=C tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9_.-' '_')"; if [ ! -f "$mk" ]; then echo "[mARC] hook script not found: $script (is PLUGIN_ROOT set for this harness?)" >&2;  touch "$mk" 2>/dev/null; fi; fi; exit 0

export CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-$PWD}"; export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="${CODEX_PROJECT_DIR:-${OLDPWD:-$PWD}}"; script="${PLUGIN_ROOT:-$PWD}/hooks/invariants-card.sh"; if [ -f "$script" ]; then bash "$script" 2>/dev/null; else st="${MARC_STATE_DIR:-$HOME/.claude/marc-state}/hook-missing"; mkdir -p "$st" 2>/dev/null; sid="$(cat 2>/dev/null | LC_ALL=C sed -n -e 's/.*"session_id"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' -e 's/.*"conversationId"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -n1)"; sid="${sid:-${ANTIGRAVITY_CONVERSATION_ID:-$PPID}}"; mk="$st/$(printf '%s' "${sid:-nosession}_invariants-card.sh" | LC_ALL=C tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9_.-' '_')"; if [ ! -f "$mk" ]; then echo "[mARC] hook script not found: $script (is PLUGIN_ROOT set for this harness?)" >&2;  touch "$mk" 2>/dev/null; fi; fi; exit 0
